about: An open-source gym and body-weight tracker for phones, with routines, workout logging and imports from other apps.

prs.title: Strong imports keep warm-ups and failure sets
prs.broken: Imports from the Strong app ignored what kind of set each row was. Rest timers became extra sets, warm-ups counted toward volume, and sets to failure lost their mark.
prs.changed: The importer now reads Strong's Set Order column. Rest rows are skipped, notes go on the exercise, warm-ups are marked as warm-ups, and failure sets stay flagged.
prs.matters: Workout history moved over from Strong now shows the right sets and the right training volume.
